title: 4/12 shadow pick file overwritten with production's pick: a real DISAGREES day recorded as AGREES
tier_reason: research-integrity failure: the shadow stream silently recorded production's pick as its own (byte-identical file), masking a real disagreement, and the load path erased the sign of corruption; repair of the 4/12 record is not evidenced

contract.text: The shadow model's daily pick is computed from its own predictions and written independently of production's pick.

mechanism.text: select_pick short-circuits to the saved production DailyPick once production is locked (game started or bluesky_posted); _run_shadow_prediction called the same select_pick after production locked, so it returned production's pick and save_shadow_pick wrote it to {date}.shadow.json
load_shadow_pick forced bluesky_posted=False and bluesky_uri=None on every load, so the next save-back erased the evidence of a corrupted shadow file

residual.text: whether data/picks/2026-04-12.shadow.json was regenerated after the fix is not evidenced; a still-corrupted row would bias shadow agreement reads

watchdog.trigger: a shadow pick file is byte-identical to production's for the date (same run_time) or carries bluesky_posted=True
watchdog.recovery_assertion: each shadow file comes from the shadow run, with its own run_time and bluesky_posted=False

evidence.what: repro on 4/12: production's pick differed from the real shadow top (a real DISAGREES day), yet 2026-04-12.shadow.json was byte-identical to the production file (same run_time microseconds); 4/10 and 4/11 escaped (manual verification; Fly in shadow_mode)

load_shadow_pick force-overrode bluesky_posted=False and bluesky_uri=None on every load, 'a secondary masking layer' that would reset the corrupted file's bluesky_posted=True on the next check-results save-back
